title: The Race to Defend Kyiv Against Terrifying New Jet-Powered Drones
summary: Ukrainian engineers are rushing to perfect A.I.-guided, jet-driven interceptors. Their goal: to stop a fast Russian threat in the latest round of a deadly tech duel.
